description: Figure 4 presents a runtime comparison between the proposed ensemble model and various LLM models on the SEconvo dataset. The chart visually compares the performance of two frameworks: the Joint Framework and the Dual-LLM Framework. The horizontal axis lists the models, while the vertical axis represents the run-time in seconds. The Joint Framework has a run-time of 77 seconds, which is highlighted as the fastest. In contrast, the Dual-LLM Framework has a significantly longer run-time of 172 seconds. This visual comparison underscores the trade-off between computational efficiency and performance, with the Joint Framework offering a much faster execution time.
